title: How Much Can We Forget about Data Contamination?
authors_zh: Sebastian Bordt, Suraj Srinivas, Valentyn Boreiko, Ulrike von Luxburg
paper_type_zh: 基准污染与训练遗忘的受控实验研究
best_for_zh: 需要量化训练数据污染对基准评测影响的研究者。
one_line: Controlled training experiments measure when repeated benchmark exposure is forgotten as training data scales.
基准污染的影响取决于重复次数、模型与训练规模；大量后续新数据可使早期污染痕迹自然遗忘。
why: It replaces an all-or-nothing leakage assumption with a measurable interaction among repetition, training scale, and weight decay.
inclusion_reason: Its controlled experiments audit how benchmark contamination changes evaluation outcomes.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Benchmark exposure is often treated as sufficient to invalidate an evaluation, although large-scale training may dilute a single observation. The missing quantity is how contamination interacts with model size, repetition, training-token scale, and the position of an example in the training stream.

The paper inserts benchmark questions into controlled pre-training data and measures the accuracy gap to a never-seen holdout. It then asks whether continued novel training and AdamW weight decay explain when the effect disappears, rather than using a black-box detector to infer provenance.

基准题出现在训练数据中常被视为足以使评测失效，但大规模训练可能稀释单个观察的影响。关键缺口是：污染如何与模型规模、重复次数、训练 token 规模及样本在训练流中的位置相互作用。

论文将基准题插入受控预训练数据，以从未见过的留出题为参照测量准确率差；随后检验持续的新数据训练和 AdamW 权重衰减能否解释影响何时消失，而不是用黑盒检测器推断溯源。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a controlled scaling account of contamination: repeated benchmark items can cause large overfitting under Chinchilla-scale training, yet can be forgotten after enough clean data. The evaluation object is a contaminated or holdout question and its model likelihood/accuracy.

The authors connect this empirical effect to the optimizer: cumulative AdamW weight decay bounds past-gradient influence, while observed forgetting is often faster. The paper releases code, not a new training dataset; its result is an audit model of conditions, not permission to ignore benchmark overlap.

论文给出污染的受控缩放解释：在 Chinchilla 规模训练下，重复的基准题会造成显著过拟合；但在足够多干净数据之后，它们又可能被遗忘。评测对象是污染题或留出题，以及模型在其上的似然和准确率。

作者把经验现象连到优化器：AdamW 的累计权重衰减为过去梯度影响给出上界，而实际遗忘往往更快。论文开放的是代码而非新训练数据集；它提供的是条件化审计模型，不是忽略基准重叠的许可。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Construct a controlled corpus. The authors train GPT-3-style models up to 1.6B parameters on FineWeb-Edu and mix seven benchmarks; 10,000 holdout questions are never trained on, while other balanced subsets are inserted 4, 12, 36, or 144 times at random positions after near-duplicate filtering.
  1. Scale and measure. They vary parameters, tokens, and repetitions, then compare zero-shot accuracy of contaminated questions with holdout questions. They also continue training after an early contamination interval and repeat the analysis from an OLMo-1B checkpoint.
  1. Explain forgetting. They vary AdamW weight decay, derive cumulative decay as an upper bound on past-gradient influence, and analyze OLMo-7B and Llama 3 405B schedules. Official code exists; exact compute, seeds, and all training-data versions must be pinned before reproduction.

1. 构造受控语料。作者以 FineWeb-Edu 训练最高 1.6B 参数的 GPT-3 风格模型，并混合 7 个基准；10,000 道留出题从不进入训练，其余平衡子集在去近重复后随机插入 4、12、36 或 144 次。
  1. 缩放并测量。作者改变参数量、token 数和重复次数，比较污染题与留出题的零样本准确率；还在早期污染区间后继续训练，并从 OLMo-1B checkpoint 重复分析。
  1. 解释遗忘。作者改变 AdamW 权重衰减，推导累计衰减作为过去梯度影响的上界，并分析 OLMo-7B 与 Llama 3 405B 的训练日程。官方代码存在；复现前必须固定计算预算、随机种子和训练数据版本。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under fixed 7B-token training, four repetitions create a 5-point accuracy gap for a 124M model and 20 points for a 1.6B model; for a 350M model, 4, 12, 32, and 144 repetitions create 11, 25, 44, and 51 points respectively (Figure 1). This establishes the model-size and repetition dependence.

The controlled forgetting result is equally important: after 15× Chinchilla training, the 124M model’s 12× contamination gap falls within the holdout confidence interval, and OLMo-1B loses 96% of a 15-point gain after less than 1% of remaining training (Figures 1–3). It supports conditional forgetting, not safety from recent or repeated leakage.

在固定 7B token 训练中，4 次重复使 124M 模型产生 5 个 accuracy point 的差距、1.6B 模型产生 20 个点；对 350M 模型，4、12、32、144 次分别产生 11、25、44、51 个点（图 1）。这证明了模型规模和重复次数的依赖关系。

受控遗忘结果同样关键：15× Chinchilla 训练后，124M 模型的 12× 污染差距落入留出集置信区间；OLMo-1B 在不足剩余训练 1% 后失去 15 点提升中的 96%（图 1–3）。这支持条件化遗忘，不意味着近期或高频泄漏安全。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior work establishes that contamination can inflate benchmarks or estimates its effect without training-data access. This paper instead retrains controlled models to map the joint dependence on repetition, data scale, and model size, then studies natural forgetting rather than only memorization.

Its novelty is the claim that data scaling can eliminate even heavily repeated early contamination and that cumulative weight decay offers a usable bound. It does not show that unknown web-scale data is clean, nor that every benchmark exposure is forgotten; verify recency, repetition, and optimizer schedule before reuse.

既有工作证明污染会抬高基准，或在不知道训练数据时估计影响。本文改为重新训练受控模型，描绘重复、数据规模和模型规模的联合依赖，并研究自然遗忘而非只讨论记忆。

新意在于：数据扩展可消除早期的高频污染，而累计权重衰减给出可用上界。它没有证明未知网页数据干净，也没有证明所有基准暴露都会遗忘；复用前需核查样本新近性、重复次数和优化器日程。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The authors limit the claim to benchmark-question leakage during pre-training; it does not directly address privacy leakage, semantic paraphrases, fine-tuning, or deployment-time contamination. Treating the result as a general contamination clearance would therefore erase the paper’s central condition.

The controlled setting needs known insertions and filtered near duplicates, unlike most proprietary corpora. Before applying its estimates, audit exposure timing and repetition and verify that the assumed AdamW schedule and weight decay are actually known.

作者将结论限定为预训练中的基准题泄漏；它不直接处理隐私泄漏、语义改写、微调或部署期污染。若把结果当作通用“污染已排除”，就会抹掉论文最关键的条件。

受控设置要求知道插入位置并过滤近重复题，这与多数私有语料不同。使用其估计前，应审计暴露时机和重复次数，并核验 AdamW 日程与权重衰减是否真的已知。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use the protocol to quantify an exposed benchmark’s likely distortion when you control training logs: insert an isolated holdout, vary repetition or training continuation, and report the contaminated–holdout accuracy gap. The output is a condition-specific audit curve.

For long pre-training runs, compute cumulative weight decay from the real schedule as a screening estimate, then validate on held-out exposures. Do not use it when training provenance, exposure time, or optimizer settings are unknown.

若掌握训练日志，可用该协议量化暴露基准的可能失真：设置隔离留出集，改变重复次数或后续训练量，并报告污染题与留出题的准确率差。产出应是条件特异的审计曲线。

对长预训练，可由真实日程计算累计权重衰减作初筛，再以留出暴露验证；若训练溯源、暴露时间或优化器配置未知，则不应使用该方法。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: contamination is a scaling-and-timing effect, not an all-or-nothing label.
  2. Mechanism: insert filtered benchmark questions, compare them with a never-seen holdout, then continue novel training.
  3. Artifact: code is released at tml-tuebingen/forgetting-contamination; the paper does not release a new training dataset.
  4. Evidence: 350M models show 11 to 51 accuracy points across 4 to 144 repetitions; OLMo-1B loses 96% of a 15-point gain quickly.
  5. Reuse: use only with logged exposure and optimizer history; first establish a matched holdout.

1. 定位：污染是规模与时间位置效应，不是非黑即白标签。
  2. 方法抓手：插入去重后的基准题，与从未见过的留出题比较，再继续以新数据训练。
  3. 数据抓手：代码发布于 tml-tuebingen/forgetting-contamination；论文未发布新训练数据集。
  4. 证据锚点：350M 模型在 4 至 144 次重复中有 11 至 51 个 accuracy point；OLMo-1B 很快失去 15 点提升中的 96%。
  5. 复用决定：仅适用于有暴露和优化器日志的训练；首先建立匹配的留出集。
